releases.new: Send a failed cell's code and traceback to your connected coding agent from the editor footer.
releases.breaking: marimo 0.26 requires Python 3.11 or newer; upgrade Python from 3.10 before upgrading marimo.

releases.new: Download geographic tables and dataframes as GeoJSON or GeoParquet, alongside the existing CSV, JSON, and Parquet options.
releases.breaking: Plots no longer auto-switch to a dark theme in dark notebooks; set the dark theme explicitly in matplotlib, Plotly, Bokeh, or HoloViews.

releases.new: Pass expand_outputs to ctx.edit_cell and ctx.create_cell to control whether the created cell's outputs are expanded.
Run notebook sandboxes with Pixi to combine Conda and PyPI packages in a notebook's inline configuration.
See storage metadata for files every time, instead of only in some cases.
Export slide-layout notebooks as reveal.js decks in static HTML or interactive WebAssembly form.
releases.breaking: Cache configuration moved from experimental.cache to cache.store, so update your marimo config; GitHub Models is replaced by GitHub Copilot.
